theme: An open day with the girls home, and two bookings worth closing.

needsAttention.detail: Your Oct 26 note agreeing to the work and asking them to come Friday Nov 6 went to a no-reply address and bounced for good this morning — Heritage doesn't have the date. A quick call to (207) 904-5900 locks it in.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 'book this week' item on your board with Mike is weeks past due. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out — a refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break has no destination yet
needsAttention.detail: Both deadlines on this one — decide by Sept 30, book by Oct 15 — have passed for the Dec 13–Jan 2 trip with all four girls. Inventory for six over the holidays only thins from here; pick domestic vs. international and lock a shortlist.
